order: terrain101 candidate then base; terrain107 base then candidate; seed61 then67; one GPU per terrain
selection: Final committed adaptation checkpoint only. No selection probes. Five evaluation and two retention starts fixed by phase-local seed schedule. No replacements.

qualification.engineering: at least one terrain gains >=0.20 completion fraction vs paired base; both learner seeds positive gain there; other terrain loses <=0.20; retention pass
qualification.stable_development: Each terrain >=9/10 completions across two independent sessions and each session >=4/5; no evaluation safety violations; engineering learning gain and retention required. Not a population guarantee or unseen-terrain qualification.
qualification.retention: Each window full 1000 steps, no fall/reset/safety violation. Per terrain/seed mean XY MAE <= max(1.10*paired_base,paired_base+0.005 m/s); each X/Y MAE <= base+0.01 m/s.
qualification.gait: Report deterministic residual RMS, foot contact duty factors and swing height on paired evaluation traces. Task completion alone is not evidence of a new gait; further gait and unseen-development-terrain confirmation required before goal completion.

failure_policy: Keep failures and uncertain charges; no aborted checkpoint promotion. Numerical/contract failure stops affected role, no automatic rescue or source edits while sessions run.
rationale: Independent replication of retained existing candidate, not a third configuration or longer training to mask Q issues. Prior Q diagnostics remain unqualified. User 2026-10-02 explicitly requests persistent learning improvement; subsequent configuration changes require separate registered new round after this result.
